decision: Select the unchanged c5c dense A0 same-host control on trn21. It is a numerical control, not a quality arm or leaderboard candidate. Dispatch remains held until all host-specific gates, independent final review, and a separate one-label authorization pass.
selection_rationale: The historical trn21 35c9 result is public2M only and does not establish a c5c public20M control. A same-host c5c control is necessary before evaluating A1 tables on trn21. The trn22 A0 r1 attempt ended before step zero and cannot substitute for this run.
required_before_dispatch: Independent PASS on the trn21 G1 retained-checkpoint evaluator result and clean postflight
Clean source staging with exact c5c and unchanged prepare.py, six authenticated warm caches and protected checkpoints
Exact-environment four-rank CPU G2 and independent numerical comparison for this host and request
A final SHA-bound request, independent final review, fresh live host and >=10-GiB disk preflight
A reviewed continuous owned-guard root-disk monitor and external step-boundary observer started before launch
A separate one-shot Supervisor authorization for this label after all above gates
